notes.title: Announcement trailer, new Steam Page and AMA
notes.content:
Hello Fishkeepers!


 We are glad we can finally publish our game page on Steam
 We dedicate the game to aquarium hobby enthusiasts and players who love fish and, in general, pets
 Our team did our best to make the game's trailer tell about mechanics Fishkeeper is offering. If you like the trailer and the game, we hope you will add it to your wishlist
 Although we tried to provide as much as possible information through the trailer, screenshots and Steam page, we realize you can have a lot of questions about the game. You can ask them in comments under this post or in the community forum
 The game is still a work-in-progress, so we are open to your ideas about new features that we should create. We hope we will create an incredible game together!


Are you able to recognize all these fish?
